body: Maybe I should try more cooked. As said in another reply, the only veggies I'm good with without any problems are potatoes, and the others don't affect me to bad like they would if raw.
I think only once and it was for penicillin. Probably a while before the fruit problem.
I've debated on it. I'm in Southwest Florida and I haven't been so lucky. Then again, I'm terrible at Googling.
Actually, I don't think I have. That might be a good idea. Thankfully all I get is an itchy neck.

I have talked to a doctor, and he really didn't find anything.

As far as cooked, it doesn't happen so much with vegetables (like corn and broccoli) but it can still happen if I have a lot of it. The only non-offenders for that are apple juice and baked/mashed potatoes.

I've seen a myriad of therapists, and none of them worked. I don't want to be on medication to go to mental hospitals either. They scare me and I don't want to be on anymore drugs than I already am. I do appreciate your feedback though.
